selected_prompts.prompt_en: Zebra herd gathered at a watering hole on the desert edge, medium-long view, multiple zebras drinking with heads down or lifting heads to watch, black-and-white stripes forming bold high-contrast patterns under strong light, ears upright with alert eyes, water reflecting stripes broken by ripples, surroundings of dry ochre ground and sparse shrubs, distant dunes layered with heat haze, intense afternoon sunlight with crisp shadows, realistic wildlife photography style with tension conveyed by posture and gaze direction
selected_prompts.prompt_cn: 斑马群在沙漠边缘饮水点聚集场景，中远景，浅水池边聚集多只斑马低头饮水或抬头警戒，黑白条纹在强光下形成高对比图案，耳朵竖起、眼神警觉，水面倒映条纹并被涟漪打碎，周围是干旱土黄色地面与稀疏灌木，远处沙丘与热雾层叠，午后日光强烈但阴影清晰，写实野外摄影风，紧张感通过姿态与视线方向呈现

selected_prompts.prompt_en: This is a realistic documentary-style photograph depicting the process of natural dyeing. In an indoor woodworking workshop, three light-colored ceramic basins sit on a table, each containing indigo, madder red, and gardenia yellow dye respectively. A craftsman uses bamboo tongs to lift a piece of linen from the indigo dye, the fabric dripping dye to create realistic gravity-induced strands and droplets. Next to it is a drying rack with three pieces of fabric in different shades of blue (light/medium/dark, with a natural gradient). The required elements are clear distinction between the materials (linen fibers, ceramic basin glaze, bamboo tong texture), natural diffused light from a window, clean, jagged edges, and a composition that uses the rule of thirds to highlight the fabric and the hand's action.
selected_prompts.prompt_cn: 还原一张草木染工艺写实纪录风照片。室内木作工坊，桌面上摆放三个浅色陶盆，分别装有靛蓝染液、茜草红染液、栀子黄染液；一位工匠正用竹夹将一块亚麻布从靛蓝染液中提起，布料滴落染液形成真实重力拉丝与水滴；旁边有一张晾晒架，上面挂着3块不同染色深浅的布（浅/中/深蓝，渐变自然）。要求材质区分清晰（亚麻纤维、陶盆釉面、竹夹纹理），光照为窗边自然散射光，边缘干净无锯齿，画面构图以三分法突出布料与手部动作。

selected_prompts.prompt_en: Viewed from a slightly right-shifted top-down angle over the sink, the toothbrush cup sits at the rear right of the counter, toothpaste laid horizontally in front of it, a towel hanging from a right-side wall hook with its end not touching the counter, all items contained within the counter boundary
selected_prompts.prompt_cn: 从洗漱台正上方略偏右的视角观察，牙刷杯位于台面右后方，牙膏横放在其前侧，毛巾挂在右侧墙面挂钩上，垂落长度不接触台面，所有物品边缘均在台面轮廓之内

selection.matchability: mean CLIP cosine to 18 best fresh COCO real images
selection.diversity: k-means over normalized CLIP text embeddings

boundary: Prompt selection reads only prompt text and fresh real images. It does not read fake images, candidate detectors or detector scores.
